description:
Short track speed skater Lee Yeo-Jun enters the athletes' village for the first time for the Winter Olympics, which are just six months away. Due to his weak physical strength and timid personality, he had long been overlooked. However, after the national team trials, a series of accidents and injuries to athletes ahead of him led to a dismal eighth-place finish, and the glorious opportunity to represent the nation finally arrived. Nervousness and excitement were fleeting, but the label of "accidentally representing the national team" weighed heavily on Yeo-Jun's heart. At his lodging, Yeo-Jun encounters Nam Ji-Hun, the current top short track speed skater and longtime love interest. He finds himself drawn to him, seemingly interested in him. The day comes, 166 days before the Olympics, when all his hard work and dedication, will be tested by the grandeur of fate.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*
